title: Pierre Keller Visiting Professor
bio: James Dennison is Professor at the Migration Policy Centre of the European University Institute in Florence and the Pierre Keller Professor at Harvard Kennedy School. His research interests include social and political attitudes, behaviour, and communication, migration, and quantitative methods and his work has been published in dozens of leading scientific journals.
